text:
noah: Ran into a support case where a user followed the quickstart and got a 402 on their first SDK call. Console showed a big 'Set payment method' button and nothing about preview models.

miri: Can you paste the SDK snippet they used and the workspace id?

noah: They used the Python quickstart, workspace rdw-onboard-9. Snippet was verbatim from docs:
```py
client.responses.create(model='redwood-1.0', input='hi')
```
Response was: {"error":{"code":402,"message":"Workspace payment method required: rdw-onboard-9"}}

sam: We removed the one-shot free call for production models last quarter. The quickstart should show a preview model fallback for trial runs to avoid this confusion.

noah: Any preferred preview model name we can recommend in the docs? The user wanted a frictionless first impression.

sam: Use `redwood-mini-preview` in onboarding examples. It has a small free allowance and isn't blocked by the payment method requirement.

miri: Action items: devex will add a one-line note in quickstart plus an inline example showing how to set the preview model. Also file a small UX ticket to update the console copy so the button explains the gating.

noah: I'll update the support reply with the preview model workaround and link to the quickstart patch once it's up.

devex-bot: Runbook reference added: https://go/runbooks/onboarding-billing-blocks

sam: Thanks all 1: let's also add a CS FAQ snippet so reps can explain why the trial behavior changed.

noah: Marking this resolved on the case after the customer confirmed the preview call worked.
